svg.title: Brightside Lane Group nail ear care portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional pet grooming portfolio concept for Brightside Lane Group, showing a tidy nail and ear care setup with unbranded grooming tools. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
